profile.name: PLC控制粗抽真空泵
profile.description: 用于真空系统前级抽气的粗抽真空泵，通过PLC接口进行启停控制，并提供状态信息和压力读回。常用于在高真空泵投入运行前，先将腔体抽至低真空范围。
profile.description_en: A roughing pump for the foreline stage of a vacuum system, controlled through a PLC interface with start/stop control and status and pressure readback. It is typically used to bring a chamber down to the low-vacuum range before high-vacuum pumps are brought online.

registry.name: Process Control PLC
registry.description: Process Control PLC是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、泵送、运行。支持Signal, Slot, egu等操作。
